verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only payment-enablement data services under the 'pay' docs: ACH account details, account ownership verification, balance checks, payment-success prediction, and deposit/bill-payment switching. Nothing documents actually initiating a payment from a connected account, and no live geographies for such a product are stated. Payment initiation is a fair axis for an open-finance platform, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.
